_comment: Risk classification for this deployment's own tools (REMORA_TOOL_METADATA_FILE). REMORA's TOOL_REGISTRY classifies six names; without this file every tool below would fall to the fail-closed floor of critical/unknown and no read could ever be ACCEPTed. The declaration is additive only — a name REMORA already classifies is refused here — and its resolved content is hashed into REMORA's policy bundle identity, so editing this file invalidates every execution lease issued under the old classification. Changing a tier is a policy change, not a config tweak.
